import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys,os,re
LANE=os.getcwd()
plan={"url":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.16810","routes":["353552"],"destination":"sources/2607.16810.pdf","source_identity":"arXiv 2607.16810, 2026 paper on the unlabeled list color function reported by search as related work","purpose":"Check whether this 2026 related paper cites any resolution of the K_{2,n} threshold conjecture for 353552"}
w=os.path.join(LANE,'write_lane.py')
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,'plans/get-353552-2026.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1),text=True,capture_output=True);print('w',r.returncode,r.stderr)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',os.path.join(LANE,'source_get_guard.py'),'plans/get-353552-2026.json'],text=True,capture_output=True)

    print(len(t),w.returncode)

    for pat in [r'K2,',r'K_\{2',r'threshold',r'\\sqrt',r'Theta',r'Θ',r'Conjecture']:
        locs=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(pat,t)]
        print('PAT',pat,len(locs))
    for m in list(re.finditer(r'threshold|K2,',t))[:25]:
        print('...',t[max(0,m.start()-200):m.start()+260].replace('\n',' '))
        print('===')
